scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build -w @capybara-devtools/ui && npm run build -w capybara-devtools && npm run build -w @capybara-devtools/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run package -w @capybara-devtools/desktop
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win -w @capybara-devtools/desktop
scripts.desktop:package:linux: npm run build && npm run package:linux -w @capybara-devtools/desktop
scripts.desktop:package:all: npm run build && npm run package:all -w @capybara-devtools/desktop
scripts.desktop:release: npm run build && npm run release -w @capybara-devtools/desktop
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run build && changeset publish && node scripts/push-release-tags.mjs
